findings.title: Widened auto-merge authority reuses the docs-only-era founder opening receipt; no fresh opening required
findings.detail: The plan keeps the stored flag `auto_merge_narrow_gate`, keeps its current value, and explicitly declines a fresh founder opening (line 88: `Lead ruling 89ec6c1b... confirms deployment needs no fresh opening`; design-verification.md repeats it). But the meaning of the value `auto` changes fundamentally. Today that value is contractually bound to a narrow scope: packages/config/src/feature-flags/registry.ts:817-838 documents `auto 仅代批同时通过机器纯文档、人声明 pure_docs、强度二证据的卡`, packages/teamlead/src/auto-narrow/eligibility.ts:65-95 hard-requires machine_class==='docs_only' AND declared_class==='pure_docs' AND strength-two satisfied, and packages/flywheel-comm/src/auto-narrow-contract.ts:validateObservation fails closed unless machine_class==='docs_only'. After this plan, the same unchanged flag value authorizes automatic approval of ANY change an LLM judges to pass three points, including arbitrary code. That is the single largest authority expansion in the system, granted by re-using a consent artifact obtained for a much narrower scope. Two concrete consequences: (1) the ceremony that exists precisely to make this deliberate is bypassed - packages/teamlead/src/bridge/auto-narrow-control-route.ts requires an authenticated, exact-channel, unedited, age-checked, confirm-token-bound founder Discord message to move the mode, and controlAuthority is declared `founder_message` with the note that production writes require such a message; a Lead ruling cannot widen founder-scoped consent. (2) The durable provenance will misstate consent: plan §4 puts `control event/opening event/flag revision` in every approval envelope, so each three-point auto-approval of a code change will cite, as its authorization evidence, the founder message that opened the docs-only gate. Compounding this, the plan's own policy provenance is admitted-unresolved on the same line (`Founder 16:27 ruling in FLY-2673 thread ... resolve through Lead before implementation acceptance`) and progress.md records `exact founder provenance pending 1fa1704c` - a second-hand quote from another issue's thread with no message id, in a design whose §6 demands cryptographic message binding for far smaller acts. Requested change: make the new policy fail closed to dry_run on deploy and require a fresh founder opening carrying policy identity `three-point-auto-v1` before the writer may mint any approval; bind the exact 16:27Z founder message id (channel+message+digest) as policy provenance before implementation acceptance; do not let the pre-existing opening_event_id serve as the opening receipt for the widened policy.

findings.title: No rate cap or circuit breaker on automatic approvals once the docs-only restriction is removed
findings.detail: Task 3 specifies `bounded 20 candidates/200ms pump` - a throughput bound per tick, not a rate cap on approvals. The existing gate needs none because eligibility is confined to docs-only cards (auto-narrow/eligibility.ts gate1/gate2); once that confinement is removed, the pump can mint up to 20 approvals per tick with no cooldown, no per-hour ceiling and no consecutive-approval breaker. Every other budget in this subsystem is explicitly capped (delivery.ts:337 posts>=2/h, delivery.ts:338 patches>=6/h, opinions.ts:216-218 10-minute spacing and 6/h) - the approval path is the only unbounded one. §5's rollback boundary makes the sole stop a founder Discord ceremony, so a systematically wrong evaluator overnight has no bounded blast radius. Add an explicit per-hour/per-run approval ceiling plus a consecutive-auto-approval breaker that degrades to dry_run and alerts, and put it in acceptance matrix §8.

findings.title: Read-side isTrustedApprovalAttribution consumers are not enumerated or dispositioned
findings.detail: Task 2 says only `reserve actor in generic ingress/founder-attribution` (the isReservedApprovalAttribution write-side guard) and §2's consumer table lists founder-attribution.ts without naming its readers. Three live read-side consumers of isTrustedApprovalAttribution will silently treat a three-point machine approval as untrusted: packages/flywheel-comm/src/commands/verify-approval.ts:551 (returns response_not_founder_attributed), packages/teamlead/src/bridge/external-merge-reconcile.ts:270 (the FLY-945 Fix D narrow external-merge recovery will not recognise a machine-approved run whose PR is merged outside the land executor), and packages/flywheel-comm/src/founder-review.ts:412. Not trusting the machine actor is very likely the correct choice and matches §4.2's `never label it founder_verified`, but the plan promises to `enumerate remaining callsites with purpose instead of deleting other consumers blindly` (§2) and does not do so here. State each disposition explicitly, especially external-merge-reconcile, where the current silent-false outcome leaves an auto-approved+externally-merged run unreconciled.

findings.title: New retirement adapter duplicates an existing legacy-freeze path that only runs in dry_run, leaving already-frozen messages with now-false text
findings.detail: §5 proposes a fresh `ship-judgment/legacy-retirement.ts` that PATCHes old bot-owned messages to `旧三闸已退役，以本卡三点判断为准`, and §2 marks bridge/auto-narrow-opinion-delivery.ts for deletion. But that exact retirement already exists and ships today: StateStore.ts:59012-59060 (invalidateAutoNarrowLegacyFreezeOnStartup / requestAutoNarrowLegacyFreeze / listAutoNarrowLegacyFreezeWork / beginAutoNarrowLegacyFreeze / finishAutoNarrowLegacyFreeze) driven by auto-narrow-opinion-delivery.ts:104-170, which patches the message to `旧三闸历史意见：当前试判见本卡的新机器意见；仍由 founder 批准。`. Two problems the plan does not address. (a) That sweep is gated on `deps.mode === 'dry_run'` (line 105), so under the current auto mode it has never run - the plan should say whether it inherits the freeze tables/state or starts clean. (b) Rows already frozen carry the sentence `仍由 founder 批准`, which becomes false the moment auto approves without a human; the mechanism that reopens frozen rows for re-patching is exactly invalidateAutoNarrowLegacyFreezeOnStartup, which §2 (plugin.ts:13325) removes. Without a replacement, stale founder-visible text asserting human approval survives in threads under an auto-approving policy. Either reuse the existing freeze schema/adapter or state explicitly how already-frozen rows are re-retired.

findings.title: Founder page never states that automatic approval now covers code changes, not only documentation
findings.detail: Section 01 says `开自动，只改变谁来执行批准` (turning on auto only changes who executes the approval). That is true within the new policy but understates the actual delta being asked for: before this change the auto mode could only approve cards the machine classified docs_only with a Lead pure_docs declaration; after it, it can approve any change passing three points. Section 03 only says the old criteria `不再参与判定` (no longer participate in the decision), which reads as a simplification rather than a widening. Section 07 says the old gate is deleted and history retained. Nowhere does the page tell the founder in plain language: the system can now merge code automatically. This is the single fact she most needs to weigh, and it is the fact that the HIGH finding above turns on. Add one sentence to section 01 or 03 stating the before/after scope, and state whether a fresh opening will be requested.

findings.title: Approval-time re-collected mechanical evidence is not explicitly tied to the dirty/candidate machinery that keeps the card honest
findings.detail: §4.1(3) requires mechanical validation 0-60 seconds old and says `Fresh material must be re-collected/revalidated even for unchanged opinion, and its digest is frozen in the approval intent`, while in the same guard set requiring `validated presentation digest matches` and `dirty_since IS NULL` and `latest_candidate_json/digest NULL`. The invariant the design clearly wants - never approve on evidence the founder could not see on the card - only holds if a re-collection whose result differs from the delivered card is required to set dirty_since / produce a new candidate rather than being consumed directly by the writer. The plan never states that linkage, and §8 row E only covers the deny direction (`old can never approves`). Since §4.1(4) also forbids network waits inside the lock, the re-collection necessarily happens outside the transaction, which is exactly where the two paths can diverge. Spell out that approval-time re-collection feeds the same dirty/candidate path as the scanner, and add an acceptance row for `fresh mechanical differs from delivered card but still passes`.

findings.title: Removing the legacy summary line and hardcoded dry_run label re-dirties every live ship card at deploy
findings.detail: render.ts hardcodes `· dry_run` in both branches (lines 52 and 85) and emits `旧窄口三闸/样本统计（非本次语义得分）` (lines 60 and 95). §2 removes both, which changes the rendered text - and therefore the presentation digest - of every currently delivered opinion card simultaneously. With the 6-PATCH/hour/card cap (delivery.ts:338) this is survivable, but it is a deploy-time fan-out of Discord edits across every open ship card plus a window where no card has a validated presentation digest, i.e. a window where §4.1(3) blocks all approvals. §5 mentions re-validating rows mislabelled history but not this mass digest invalidation. Note the expected fan-out and the expected approval-quiet window in §5 or §7 task 6.

findings.title: Section 2 claims repository-relative paths but most rows are package-src-relative
findings.detail: Line 22 asserts `All paths below are repository-relative`. Most rows are not: `ship-judgment/{contract,scanner,runtime}.ts` resolves to packages/teamlead/src/ship-judgment/, `bridge/plugin.ts` to packages/teamlead/src/bridge/plugin.ts, and `auto-narrow/{eligibility,opinion}.ts` in the row at line 32 resolves to packages/teamlead/src/auto-narrow/ - not bridge/auto-narrow/, which does not exist and which the neighbouring `bridge/`-prefixed entries in the same cell invite a reader to assume. Row 28 already hedges with `(same src root)`, so the intent is clear, but the blanket claim is wrong and one cell is actively misleading. Either prefix every path with packages/teamlead/src or replace the line-22 sentence with `paths are relative to the owning package src root`.
